description: Stage3ER2 search and evaluator with (1) one pinned numba signature per jitted function so the engine imports in ~17 s cold instead of ~37 s, plus a best-effort on-disk numba cache; (2) a repetition strictly inside the search tree scores as a draw (game-history repeats still need a threefold); (3) a 4M-entry transposition table; (4) mop-up extended to two bishops (converts KBB v K, tested) and bishop+knight (corner-of-bishop-colour gradient; direction correct but the mate is not reliably executed at game depth). Node counts on ordinary positions unchanged.. Weights unchanged.
status: Final-day build. Each change validated by 40-game self-play at 5s+0.1s against the previous build.

mopup.winning_side_requirement: at least 500 cp non-king material and at least one rook or queen
mopup.implementation: O(1) evaluation-time gate using incrementally maintained non-king material/major-count summaries in unused NNUE accumulator metadata slots

anti_repeat.trigger: completed normal root move revisits a prior position in the reversible game history
anti_repeat.rescue_root_policy: exclude all root moves that revisit prior reversible history
anti_repeat.rescue_acceptance: completed depth >=6 and rescue score >= +100 cp
anti_repeat.normal_path_overhead: one post-search revisit check only when score/depth/halfmove gates pass; no second engine or extra TT

final_day_changes.high_variance_bundle: High-variance bundle: eval scaled by remaining material and faded by the fifty-move counter; reverse futility to depth 8 at 70cp/ply; null-move reduction grows with eval margin (up to +2); futility pruning to depth 4 and late-move pruning to depth 5; iteration time redistributed (score drop or changed best move earns more, a move stable for 3 iterations stops at 0.4 soft); transposition table 8M entries (128 MB); dead staged-ordering code removed from the search (2 s less compile). Guard match 40 games 5s+0.1s vs previous build: +11 =20 -9 (52.5%). Table alone: +11 =19 -10 (51.2%).
